200.description: The receipt is STOWED; the destination site's usable stock rose by exactly receivedQuantity, once. `allocations` names the StockUnits created and the bin each went into.

schema.description: The STOWED receipt plus the destination StockUnits the stow created.

allOf.description: The destination-side custody record for one transfer line (ADR 0031), keyed DB-unique on transferLineId. STAGED means counted but not yet placed (no usable stock); STOWED means placed — the destination site's usable rose exactly once.

expectedQuantity.description: What the transfer_allocations ledger promised (its requested_quantity).

receivedQuantity.description: What was physically counted at the dock.

variance.description: SIGNED received - expected. Positive = over-receipt, negative = short-receipt, 0 = exact. Explicit, never silently absorbed.

replay.description: True when this response is the ORIGINAL outcome of an idempotent replay, with nothing new written or published.

allOf.title: TransferReceipt

allocations.description: One entry per destination StockUnit created, with its bin.

schema.title: StowedTransfer

400.description: Malformed JSON body, bins missing/empty, a binId missing or empty, a quantity not positive, or the Idempotency-Key header absent (ADR 0018).
